newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banco do Nordeste gets capital hike.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banco do Nordeste gets capital hike.

text.p: The Brazilian government Saturday published a decree allowing state bank Banco do Nordeste (BNB) to increase its capital by 280 million reais, officials said.

In a re-edited version of a decree that authorized federal bank Banco do Brasil's $8.0 billion capital injection earlier this year, the government added a clause allowing the National Development Fund (FND) to buy 280 million reais of BNB shares.
The decree said the shares would be deposited in the National Privatization Fund.
The re-edited decree was one of 23, five of which were changed, published in a special edition Saturday of the government's Official Journal.
